AP EAMCET Result 2026 Declared: Your Gateway to Higher Education is Here!

The wait is finally over! The Andhra Pradesh Engineering, Agriculture and Pharmacy Common Entrance Test (AP EAMCET or AP EAPCET) 2026 results have been officially announced, paving the way for thousands of aspirants to pursue their dreams in professional courses across Andhra Pradesh.

Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU), Kakinada, on behalf of the Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE), declared the much-anticipated AP EAMCET 2026 results on July 1, 2026. Students who appeared for the examinations held between May 12 and May 20, 2026, can now access their scorecards and rank cards via the official website.

This year's results mark a significant milestone, showcasing impressive pass percentages across both Engineering and Agriculture & Pharmacy streams. It's time to check your performance and prepare for the next crucial step: counselling!

Key Highlights of AP EAMCET 2026 Results

✅ **Result Declared:** July 1, 2026.

✅ **Official Website:** cets.apsche.ap.gov.in.

✅ **Engineering Pass Percentage:** Around 70.52% of candidates qualified for engineering programmes.

✅ **Agriculture & Pharmacy Pass Percentage:** An impressive 89.59% of candidates cleared the entrance examination.

✅ **Gender Performance:** Girls outperformed boys in the Engineering stream with a 71.65% pass rate.

✅ **Toppers Announced:** Jonnala Roshan Manideep Reddy topped the Engineering stream, and Sambangi Jaswanth Naidu led the BPharm category.

How to Check Your AP EAMCET 2026 Results Online

Accessing your AP EAMCET 2026 rank card is a straightforward process. Follow these steps to download your results and plan your next move:

1. Visit the Official Website
Navigate to the official AP EAMCET 2026 website: cets.apsche.ap.gov.in. You might also find direct links on sche.ap.gov.in or via the APSCHE myCET mobile app if the main site is busy.
2. Locate the Result Link
On the homepage, look for the "AP EAPCET 2026 Result link" or "Download Rank Card" and click on it.
3. Enter Your Credentials
You will be redirected to a new page where you need to enter your registration number, hall ticket number, and date of birth. Some portals might also ask for a password or captcha.
4. View and Download Your Scorecard
After submitting the details, your AP EAMCET 2026 scorecard and rank card will be displayed on the screen. Carefully review all the information.
5. Save for Future Reference
Download the result and take multiple printouts. The rank card is a mandatory document for the upcoming counselling and admission process.

Understanding Your AP EAMCET 2026 Scorecard

Your AP EAMCET 2026 scorecard is more than just a piece of paper; it contains vital information that will guide your admission process. Ensure all details are accurate. In case of any discrepancies, contact the council authorities immediately.

✅ Candidate's Name

✅ Hall Ticket Number

✅ Registration Number

✅ Category

✅ Stream (Engineering/Agriculture & Pharmacy)

✅ Subject-wise Marks

✅ Total Marks Obtained

✅ Normalized Score

✅ Qualifying Status

✅ Admission Rank

It's important to remember that the final rank is determined by a 75:25 weightage system, with 75% given to your AP EAMCET scores and 25% to your Intermediate (Class 12) examination marks. General category candidates must score at least 25% (40 out of 160) in the EAMCET to qualify for a rank. No minimum qualifying marks are prescribed for SC/ST candidates.

The Next Big Step: AP EAMCET 2026 Counselling

With results out, the focus now shifts to the counselling process, which is expected to commence in July 2026. The Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE) will soon release a detailed schedule for counselling registration, fee payment, certificate verification, web option entry, and seat allotment.

AP EAMCET 2026 Counselling Process - A Detailed Guide

1. Counselling Fee Payment
Candidates must first register online and pay the prescribed processing fee. The counselling fee for OC/BC categories is ₹1200, and for other categories, it is ₹600. Keep your transaction ID for future reference.
2. Document Verification
After fee payment, qualified candidates must undergo document verification. This can be done both online and offline at designated helpline centers. Ensure you have all required original documents ready.
3. Web Option Entry
Once documents are verified, candidates can exercise their web options. This involves selecting preferred colleges and courses in order of priority. This step is critical, as seat allotment will be based on your choices, rank, category, and seat availability.
4. Seat Allotment
Based on your AP EAMCET 2026 rank, web options, and reservation policies, the APSCHE will allot provisional seats. You will be able to view your seat allotment order online.
5. Self-Reporting & Reporting to Allotted College
After seat allotment, candidates must self-report online and then physically report to their allotted college within the specified dates to confirm their admission by paying the fees.

Essential Documents for AP EAMCET 2026 Counselling

Be prepared with the following documents for the verification process:

✅ AP EAMCET 2026 Rank Card

✅ AP EAMCET 2026 Hall Ticket

✅ Memorandum of Marks (Intermediate or equivalent)

✅ Proof of Date of Birth (SSC or equivalent Memo)

✅ Transfer Certificate (T.C)

✅ Study Certificate from VI to Intermediate

✅ EWS certificate (for OC candidates claiming EWS reservation)

✅ Residence Certificate (for private candidates)

✅ Income Certificate (if applicable)

✅ Caste Certificate (if applicable)

✅ Aadhaar Card

✅ Passport-size Photographs

Don't Miss Out on Your Dream College!

Keep a close watch on the official AP EAMCET website for the detailed counselling schedule and notifications. Prepare your documents, understand the process, and take the next step towards a bright academic future!
